description: Recent submissions with their verdicts. Use review=true for held ones waiting for a human. Attached files are listed under files (name, size, type, kept, and a download url with the API key while the file waits).

api_key.description: Doorman API key (dm_live_...). Only needed if the MCP connection has no Authorization header.

type.description: Only this enquiry type (lead forms): sales, support, job, partnership, press, investor, other

via.description: Only submissions that came in through this form tool's webhook

workspace_id.description: Optional ws_...: only this client workspace's forms
